meta.planTitle: MERIDIAN: Product Plan and Source Audit
meta.currentHeadNote: M-002 commit (explicit lint, test runner, quality gate). Baseline M-001 was recorded at 17663a454dc3e2e7c9e82b0f5203129cb4186921. M-002 stays in_progress until an independent reviewer runs the gate.
meta.schemaNote: Tickets are transcribed verbatim from the plan's Roadmap and Prioritized Backlog (Phase 0-5). Sizes S/M/L are relative complexity, not durations. Phase order describes dependencies, not promised dates.

gates.G0: Safe foundation: baseline recorded; explicit lint and checks; demo boundary; paid-refresh containment; no new critical regression.
gates.G1: Trustworthy discovery: reviewed catalog, date certainty, consistent event query, public routes, mobile list fallback, usable event details.
gates.G2: Real collaboration: two-device trip/message/invite demonstration; cross-account negative tests; revocation and notification handling.
gates.G3: Commercial pilot: approved provider flow, scoped consent, real request delivery, disclosures, attribution definitions, an operational owner.
gates.G4: Public release: accessibility/performance evidence, backup/restore rehearsal, policies reviewed, moderation/support coverage, controlled pilot results.
gates.G5: Expansion: measured repeat use, provider outcomes and economics justify the next feature; no unresolved trust regressions.

statusLegend.in_progress: Actively being worked in the current Phase 0 cycle.
statusLegend.blocked: Cannot start until a named dependency or approval clears.

phase0Findings.title: Public force-refresh can fan out across the entire calendar
The visible event path does not consume the enriched API result
phase0Findings.priority: P1, or P0 before advertising live data
phase0Findings.evidence: Source-confirmed in the plan audit (useEvents returns bundled EVENTS); not separately re-exercised in BASELINE.md.

phase0Findings.title: Social behavior is a detailed local demo, not a network
phase0Findings.priority: P0 before calling the product multi-user

phase0Findings.title: Prototype states can imply transactions that never occurred
Event dates and signal values lack sufficient provenance in the core contract
phase0Findings.evidence: Source-visible in src/lib/types.ts (no certainty/evidence fields on WorldEvent); not listed among BASELINE.md verifications.

phase0Findings.title: The lint command does not match Next.js 16
Memoization keys cannot uniquely represent mutable event data
phase0Findings.evidence: Key design visible in src/lib/selectors/index.ts (`${events.length}|${count}:${sum}|${focus}`); runtime collision not reproduced in BASELINE.md.

phase0Findings.title: Client/server separation relies on import discipline
phase0Findings.evidence: src/lib/data/index.ts re-exports source functions without a server-only guard; bundle inspection not performed in BASELINE.md.

phase0Findings.title: The layout is desktop-first and important text is very small
Global keyboard handling can conflict with controls
The calendar horizon advances, but the seeded catalog does not automatically roll forward
Testing and delivery need to expand with the product
No-WebGL fallback unreachable: three r185 logs the context failure instead of throwing, so GlobeErrorBoundary never catches, `ready` never flips, and the loading overlay persists indefinitely
phase0Findings.priority: P0 (public discovery must work without WebGL)

tickets.title: Establish reproducible baseline
acceptance: Fresh lockfile installation and declared Node version recorded.
Typecheck, dataset validator, build, lint and browser checks have actual pass/fail/blocked evidence.
Original globe/selection/date/filter flows captured.

tickets.title: Repair lint and explicit quality gate
acceptance: Compatible explicit lint configuration replaces next lint.
Gate includes lint, typecheck, dataset checks, tests as introduced, and build.
Lockfile committed and independent reviewer runs the gate.

tickets.title: Isolate simulated social activity
acceptance: Demo mode is prominently labeled and separate from real mode.
Production cannot present generated users/messages as real.
Existing demo interactions remain reviewable and no local real drafts are silently erased.

tickets.title: Contain forced vendor refresh and fan-out
acceptance: Public force-refresh is removed or denied; only authorized jobs/admin actions refresh.
Subset refresh tests prove bounded upstream workload.
Refresh concurrency, request limits, budgets, and failure behavior are documented.

tickets.title: Define safe server/client boundaries
acceptance: Credential-bearing modules are isolated and server-only.
Public selectors import safe contracts/read models only.
Client-bundle inspection finds no secret values.

tickets.title: Approve flow, route and contract map
acceptance: Existing product contracts to preserve are documented.
Public/private routes and seven core user actions have approved flow diagrams.
One integrator owns shared contracts and file boundaries.

tickets.title: Add event occurrence and evidence schema
acceptance: Series and occurrence identities are separate.
Dates support certainty, lifecycle, windows, timezone and field-level evidence.
Compatibility view model preserves current Beacon mapping.

tickets.title: Integrate a single versioned event query
acceptance: Globe, list, calendar and detail read the same versioned dataset.
A verified data change appears in all views.
Public reads do not call vendors directly.

tickets.title: Replace lossy score cache keys
acceptance: Same-count event changes invalidate scoring.
Equal-and-opposite peer changes cannot return stale scores.
Focus-date behavior remains consistent with characterization tests.

tickets.title: Specify responsive visual design system
acceptance: Tokens, type scale, interaction states and reusable components are approved.
Desktop/tablet/mobile layouts are specified.
Globe palette is preserved; reading sizes and touch behavior improve.

tickets.title: Create landing and route shell
acceptance: Root landing and /explore resolve without route conflicts.
Explore CTA works anonymously.
No fake social proof or full WebGL dependency on landing.

tickets.title: Build responsive explorer and list fallback
acceptance: Core discovery works on 360-430px widths.
Globe remains accessible through a clear toggle.
No-WebGL users can search, filter, select and proceed to planning.

tickets.title: Create canonical event briefing pages
acceptance: Each published occurrence has a public stable URL.
Dates, certainty, access, sources and Save/Plan actions are visible.
Private member data is absent from public HTML and metadata.

tickets.title: Build editorial review administration
acceptance: Editors can draft/review/publish/archive with audit history.
Uncertain/conflicting dates and source errors enter queues.
Unauthorized accounts cannot publish.

tickets.title: Verify pilot event catalog
acceptance: 30-50 chosen occurrences have reviewed evidence and certainty labels.
Unverified remainder stays unpublished or demo-only.
Material change and cancellation fixtures pass validation.

tickets.title: Provision auth and least-privilege roles in approved environment
acceptance: Provider selection and environment are approved before provisioning.
Sign-in/sign-out/session handling work; roles are not client-editable.
Exposed data has tested RLS and secret separation.

tickets.title: Add saved events and selective local import
acceptance: Real saves persist across two devices.
Registration preserves the selected occurrence.
Import only genuinely user-authored saves after consent; no synthetic data.

tickets.title: Repair keyboard and focus ownership
acceptance: Space activates focused buttons, not global timeline play.
Dialogs own shortcuts/focus correctly.
Escape, arrows and tab navigation pass manual keyboard checks.

tickets.title: Add coverage and clock lifecycle handling
acceptance: Coverage gaps are explicit beyond reviewed data.
Long-lived sessions and timezone boundaries are tested.
Unknown annual dates are not automatically invented.

tickets.title: Add public metadata and eligible structured data
acceptance: Sitemap contains published public pages only.
Event markup is truthful and eligibility-aware.
Demo, drafts and private trips have no public indexable output.

tickets.title: Implement private trip persistence and membership
acceptance: Organizer creates a trip linked to a real occurrence.
Trip memberships are server-authorized and transactionally constrained.
Unrelated users fail read/write negative tests.

tickets.title: Implement secure invitation delivery and acceptance
acceptance: Expiry, hash storage, recipient binding, revocation and one-time acceptance work.
Email scanners do not consume invites on GET.
Delivery failures and retry states are honest and idempotent.

tickets.title: Build private trip-room interface
acceptance: Overview, plans, discussion, services and people are coherent on desktop/mobile.
Single-organizer empty state is useful.
Privacy and member controls are visible.

tickets.title: Implement real text conversation and reconnect
acceptance: Two independent sessions exchange stored messages.
Reconnection, ordering, retry and duplicate-send tests pass.
Revoked members lose future data access and channel permissions.

tickets.title: Add planning options and simple decisions
acceptance: Members add options and make a lightweight poll/decision.
Pinned decisions have author/time and edit permissions.
Selected services do not falsely change booking status.

tickets.title: Add notifications and communication preferences
acceptance: Members choose transactional notification preferences.
Notifications are deduplicated and failure-aware.
No private message or token leaks into logs/analytics.

tickets.title: Build trip/saved overview and safe export
acceptance: Member sees only their own authorized trips and saves.
Calendar export handles local dates and estimated windows explicitly.
Private export/share behavior is reviewed and revocable where applicable.

tickets.title: Verify multi-account isolation and revocation
acceptance: A/B/C account and cross-organization test matrix passes.
Direct APIs, database policies, metadata, realtime and storage are tested.
Critical access failures block the collaboration gate.

tickets.title: Define provider and affiliate contracts
acceptance: Candidate program terms, disclosure, links and data-use rules are recorded.
Qualified-request definition and referral contract model are approved.
No claimed partner enrollment without actual approval.

tickets.title: Build provider and sponsor application pages
acceptance: Applications collect business/services/regions/credentials and permissions.
Sponsor and provider permissions are distinct.
Application does not automatically publish a listing.

tickets.title: Implement partner approval administration
acceptance: Approved/rejected/suspended states are audited.
Only approved profiles/offers can become public.
Partner organization roles are server-controlled.

tickets.title: Publish relevant provider profiles and offers
acceptance: Listings contain approved claims and assets with expiry.
Event relevance is explicit and sponsored entries labeled.
No unsupported availability or guaranteed access claims.

tickets.title: Implement consent-scoped service requests
acceptance: User previews fields and named recipient before sending.
Request and consent are persisted idempotently.
Other providers cannot read it or the private trip.

tickets.title: Build provider inbox and response workflow
acceptance: Provider sees only assigned consented requests.
Response states, decline, escalation and fulfillment reference are available.
Unanswered-request process has a named operating owner.

tickets.title: Add approved affiliate links and click attribution
acceptance: Program-approved links retain required tracking.
Disclosures are visible near links on mobile and desktop.
No open redirect or PII in tracking parameters.

tickets.title: Reconcile conversion and referral outcomes
acceptance: Clicks/inquiries/booked/fulfilled/commission/cash are separate.
Duplicates, cancellations and manual adjustments are auditable.
Dashboard never presents GMV as MERIDIAN revenue.

tickets.title: Add reports, block controls and moderation queue
acceptance: Members can report inappropriate contact/content.
Moderators have scoped access and audit trail.
Rate limiting and escalation coverage are tested.

tickets.title: Review policy and aviation launch boundary
acceptance: Qualified counsel reviews actual activities before high-risk launch.
No seat selling/deposits or unsupported booked/chartered states remain.
Privacy, terms, disclosure, complaint and data-retention decisions are approved.

tickets.title: Operationalize durable editorial refresh jobs
acceptance: Job schedule, budgets, backoff and evidence history are persistent.
Public page loads never trigger unbounded vendor work.
Unconfigured/error/stale/empty outcomes remain distinct.

tickets.title: Contract-test one optional live adapter
acceptance: Actual payload mapping is verified in an approved small-budget test.
Rights, limits and costs are documented.
Failure cannot corrupt published facts or mimic zero demand.

tickets.title: Complete accessibility and actual-device checks
acceptance: Primary flows pass manual keyboard/screen-reader and automated checks.
Representative iOS and Android sessions recorded.
Contrast, text scaling, mobile keyboard and no-WebGL paths pass.

tickets.title: Measure and improve public/explorer performance
acceptance: Performance baseline and agreed device/network profiles are recorded.
Public pages target good Core Web Vitals; list becomes usable before globe.
Globe quality and motion degrade gracefully without breaking tasks.

tickets.title: Implement observability, backup and rollback operations
acceptance: Sensitive data is redacted from logs.
Backup restore and feature-disable/rollback are rehearsed.
Source/provider/notification failures reach a responsible owner.

tickets.title: Run controlled traveler/provider pilot
acceptance: Actual users/providers are recruited with approved outreach.
Predefined core-loop measures and interview findings are recorded.
No fake activity or changed goalposts substitutes for evidence.

tickets.title: Prepare public launch decision
acceptance: G0-G4 evidence is reviewed by the product owner.
Critical defects, privacy risks and operational gaps are resolved or launch is held.
Production release is explicitly approved.

tickets.title: Test sponsor placement with measured inventory
acceptance: A real sponsor agreement defines inventory, reporting and labels.
No organic score is manipulated.
Renewal discussion uses actual outcomes, not invented reach.

tickets.title: Pilot advisor multi-client workspace
acceptance: Repeated advisor demand is documented first.
Client-room isolation and team delegation have negative tests.
Pricing experiment and support cost are measured.

tickets.title: Add moderated public event questions only if warranted
acceptance: Repeated public-question demand justifies the feature.
Moderation and clear provider/editor labeling exist.
Private plans and member attendance are never exposed by default.

tickets.title: Add opt-in overlap discovery only if safe and demanded
acceptance: Member explicitly opts in to a defined visibility scope.
Exact live location, manifests and sensitive details remain private.
Blocking, reporting and revocation work before release.

tickets.title: Evaluate subscription and selective expansion
acceptance: Recurring benefit and actual willingness to pay are demonstrated.
Contribution economics include data, editorial and support cost.
Next investment is approved based on evidence; aviation transactions remain separately gated.
